Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the team liked the latency numbers and the cost estimates you showed. Procurement is asking for a quick readout on the commercial path so they can scope vendor onboarding. A few items they need clarified: 

- Will Redwood accept a standard PO and invoice (Net 30)? If so, what legal entity should the PO be issued to and what remit address do we use?
- For pilots under $25k, will a corporate card payment be acceptable instead of going through full vendor onboarding?
- Does Redwood offer an AWS Marketplace listing (or other marketplace) that we could buy through to shorten procurement? Any pricing difference there?
- Any vendor documentation we should upload now (W-9, SOC 2 attestation, vendor contact info)? I attached a vendor info template for your intake team.

Procurement's timeline: they want to confirm the path by the end of next week to start paperwork. Can you confirm the options and what paperwork you need from Helios?

Thanks,
Samantha Nguyen
Head of Vendor Ops — Helios Therapeutics

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai

Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-21T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement & payment setup for Helios pilot

Hi Samantha — great to hear the demo resonated. Quick answers up front, followed by next steps: 

Answers:
- PO + invoice: Yes, we accept standard purchase orders. Please make the PO to "Redwood Inference, Inc.". Remit to: Redwood Inference, Inc., 210 Mission St, San Francisco, CA 94105. We can issue Net 30 invoices for PO customers.
- Card vs PO: For small pilots (under $15k) many customers pay by corporate card to avoid vendor setup. For pilots >$15k–$25k, procurement often prefers a PO. If Helios expects to run production or commit spend, we'll recommend PO for accounting consistency.
- Marketplace: We are listed on AWS Marketplace — purchasing there speeds procurement because you can buy via your existing marketplace contract. There is no premium on list price, but billing and invoice cadence differ (Marketplace invoices through AWS).
- Docs: Please send a completed vendor intake (the spreadsheet you attached is perfect), W-9, and preferred remit/billing contact. SOC 2 report is available; we can provide a redacted copy after an NDA/MFA step if required.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Samantha / Procurement: confirm expected pilot budget and whether you prefer to pursue AWS Marketplace or a direct PO (reply to this thread).
2) If PO: procurement uploads the completed vendor intake + W-9 to our onboarding portal (link below) and we route to Finance for vendor creation.
3) If card: we will send an invoice and a secure payment link; Finance will process and confirm receipt.
4) Vivek (cc'd) will confirm technical billing metadata we should include on invoices (usage granularity, model id).

Portal link for vendor intake: https://portal.redwood.ai/vendor-onboarding (internal link: RWI-PORTAL-449)

I attached a short commercial playbook and a one-page vendor checklist for your procurement team. Naomi from FinOps will be on the thread for any billing policy exceptions.

Appreciate a quick confirm on budget + preferred path and we'll jump on a 15-min call if useful.

— Jasmine Liu
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0189
Attachments: Commercial_Playbook_Helios_20270525.pdf; Vendor-Onboarding-Checklist.docx

Thanks Jasmine — quick clarifying notes from Procurement: 

- Pilot spend is likely to be ~ $28k (cloud credits + inference seats) so Procurement will require a PO for vendor onboarding.
- Legal entity: PO should be made out to "Helios Therapeutics, Inc." (we will provide the full legal address).
- They prefer Net 30 invoices and will push for standard T&Cs, but we may need a short SOW for the pilot that references deliverables and duration. Can Redwood provide a short engagement SOW / statement of work we can attach to the PO?
- Marketplace would be faster but procurement wants the vendor on record (for audit) which means we still need vendor creation even if purchasing via Marketplace.

I'll follow up with the full vendor intake spreadsheet and W-9 by EOD tomorrow. If you can draft a 1-page SOW for a 6-week pilot (usage-based billing, estimated spend $28k) that would help speed legal review.

Samantha
